qualification: Original synthetic UI acceptance specification; thresholds below are proposed until benchmark target review.

benchmark.methodology: Pin release/debug mode, physical machine, OS/backend, viewport, graph generator, warm-up and sample count before measurement; virtual display results do not prove physical latency.

capacity_rule: Desired tiers exceeding current model/view limits are explicit future targets; no current limit may be silently raised or workload silently truncated.
